comment: Zer0 Magazine wants an interview with Nick Chesterton.\n\tHis comeback is a big thing among their readers and Zer0 think the interview would help you promote the record.

Nick Chesterton finds out you've set him up for an interview with Zer0 Magazine, but there's just no chance he's gonna do an interview.\n\tHe has made perfectly clear that he wants nothing to do with the media.
Nick asks how long it's gonna take before you release a record.\n\tAll this indecision is making him doubt his comeback. He's just not sure whether he can do it or not.

After a few days on his holiday, Nick Chesterton is recognised by fans and reporters at the resort.\n\tHe escapes to his bungalow, but they wait outside and Nick is worried they might touch the room service meals he orders before he can eat them.

The liquor you gave Nick Chesterton has made him really ill.\n\tHe can barely speak, much less sing, and spends all day in his room with the blinds shut, plucking absent-mindedly on his guitar between the vomiting fits.

As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThey all want a piece of Nick and you have to fight to get him out of there.\n\tNick is really shaken by the incident and doubts if the comeback was such a good idea after all.

As you exit the studio, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside. Somebody must have leaked to the press that Nick was recording in <¤CPlace.name>.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards elegantly smuggle him out through an air shaft to escape the reporters. Problem solved.\n\tSome papers run admiring accounts of the movie-style escape.

There is a  huge media posse waiting outside the concert hall after the show.
	You try to wait them out, but they persist. You have to fight your way through a wall of reporter flesh!
	They don't even bother asking any questions, they just grab at Nick for a piece of hair, skin or clothes.
	Finally, you get away with Nick in disarray and bruises all over his body.

As you exit concert, there's a huge reporter posse waiting outside for you.\n\tThe Spektor bodyguards set off the fire alarm and sneak Nick out the back door, unseen by any reporter in the midst of the confusion.\n\tSomebody must have leaked the escape to the press because City News and Zer0 Magazine both print admiring descriptions of the daring escape.

After the concert, the hungry media anxiously waits to get a piece of Nick Chesterton.\n\tAs he tries to wade through the crowd, the pressure becomes too much and Nick collapses on the ground.\n\tWhen the ambulance arrives, the reporters have already left to write their pieces on celebrity hysteria, media ethics and low security at concerts.

After the concert, hungry reporters anxiously wait to get a piece of your star.\n\tThe paparazzi refuse to back down until the Spektor bodyguards pull out their guns and threaten to fire at will. That does the trick -  you can leave safely!\n\tSome media report on the incident, making Nick feel very awkward.

Nick Chesterton is angry with you because you hired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>.\n\tHe can't play with such heavy metal freaks. His music has nuances that metal heads can't even begin to fathom and if you can't understand it, then how could you play it?

Nick Chesterton is angry with you for not having fired <Missionvar.mis6NickDislikesMetalmember.name>. He is unsure if he can trust you anymore.\n\tIf you don't hire and fire the musicians he chooses, how can he trust you with the press?

Nick Chesterton is furious that you would schedule him for a video shoot.\n\tHe refuses to ever appear in any video! That goes against everything that Nick Chesterton is about.\n\tYou can cancel the shoot or make it without him.

<missionVar.Mis6Booredmusician.name> is fed up with Nick Chesterton's egoism and eccentricity.\n\tIt's so boring working with somebody who spends half the days just dealing with his neurosis.\n\tNo great music is being made.
Nick Chesterton is very upset that you would set him up for an interview, knowing about his feelings towards the media.\n\tHe refuses to be interviewed.

Nick Chesterton has managed to sell 30.000 copies and made enough money to creep back into the abyss where he used to dwell.\n\tThere's nothing more you can do for him and he's gonna be happier this way anyhow.

The music industry yearly Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies are coming up.\n\tAmong the nominees for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar is Nick Chesterton. With the nomination comes an offer to play a song live at the ceremonies which will be held in a week.\n\tThe promoters demand you pay $10.000 to do the gig, but it's great promotion.

After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.
	The stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, T-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).
	The Spektor bodyguards swiftly disperse the crowd by playing heavy metal over the PA at a painful volume.
	Nick escapes unharmed, but spends half an hour telling you how he feels about heavy metal.

After an outstanding performance at the Gold Wiener Awards Ceremonies, Nick Chesterton receives the Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar.\n\tThe stage instantly fills with languishing teens out to get Nick's autograph, t-shirt and virginity (not necessarily in that order).\n\tAt first Nick is thrilled, but it's not long before he panics and runs screaming off the stage.

You attend the Gold Wiener Awards, but Nick doesn't win anything.\n\tThe Gold Wiener for Best Depressed Young Man with Guitar goes to Eric Flanders, who played at the gala and is overjoyed as the stage fills with teenage fans wanting to celebrate his genius.
Start over and think twice about your expenses. Do you really need to use the most expensive studios and gear?
Your number one priority should be to keep Nick in the band!

Nick is torn to pieces because you have considered recording a song other than his masterpiece, Mountain of Hypocrisy.\n\tThe only thing Nick ever wanted to do was make his music  the reason why he puts up with media madness.\n\tHe immediately goes back to his cocoon with the intent to stay there forever.
